title: A TABLE EXPR parameter is evaluated in the body, under the filters the body sets
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CountRowsLater = ( t : TABLE EXPR ) => COUNTROWS ( CALCULATETABLE ( t, ALL ( 'Date' ) ) )

source.quote: The function receives an unevaluated table expression and evaluates it under ALL('Date') , removing the external year filter.
source.supports: the page gives this function and call (with a fiscal year filter) and explains the result

derivation: The argument Sales is evaluated inside CALCULATETABLE ( ..., ALL ( Date ) ), which removes the year filter of the call: all 7 rows.
